titles.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to impose an annual $1,000 tax on each cigarette vending machine, and to provide that revenues from such tax be used by the Centers for Disease Control to fund reduced tobacco use programs.

To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to impose an annual $1,000 tax on each cigarette vending machine, and to provide that revenues from such tax be used by the Centers for Disease Control to fund reduced tobacco use programs.
